attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as authoritative DNS for lan-a, resolving app.internal to node3's address (10.100.246.12) via system static-host-mapping + dns forwarding; configured node2 (OPNsense) as authoritative DNS for lan-b, resolving app.internal to node4's address (10.100.246.13) via an Unbound host override. Pointed node3's resolver at node1 and node4's resolver at node2 (nmcli, persisted). Verified resolution on both sides, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery of DNS state after each restart.
